rootCause: auditResult() abstained whenever exit bit 1 was set and zero advisories parsed. Composer 2.10's audit.abandoned=fail default sets bit 1 for abandoned packages alone, so an abandoned-only report (advisories [], abandoned {...}) abstained although its abandoned findings had already been parsed.
fix: Bit 1 is treated as parser drift only when neither advisories nor abandoned parsed anything. abandoned is also read when written as a list of package names.

pipelineStages.detail: Read ts/src/core/composer-audit.ts: abandonedFindings already parsed the object form; the bit-1 cross-check looked only at advisories.
ts/test/php-audit.test.ts before the fix: 5 failed | 15 passed (20); the 3-abandoned exit-1 fixture exited 3 instead of 1.
Same file plus gate-conformance after the fix: 50 passed (50). Revert check: reverse-applying only the source patch returns the same 5 failures.

assumptions: The list form of abandoned is a JSON array of package-name strings with no replacement; non-string entries are dropped and the exit-bit cross-check turns an all-dropped list into an abstention.
Exit bit 2 keeps its existing meaning: set with zero abandoned parsed still abstains.
The bit-1 abstain message now says 'findings' rather than 'advisories', since bit 1 no longer implies advisories; the gate-conformance row only asserts exit 3 and no 'passed', so it is unaffected.
Fixtures use generic acme/* package names instead of the package names quoted in the issue.
